chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from his father, from one who narrated to him, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Marry off the foolish man, but do not marry off the foolish woman, for the foolish man begets (children), but the foolish woman does not beget (children).
ai.seo_question: Why should foolish men be married off but foolish women not, according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) distinguishes between the reproductive longevity of men and the finite fertility of women to advise against marrying foolish women. This ruling reflects the practical concern of preserving lineage quality, as a foolish woman’s childbearing years are limited, whereas a foolish man can continue to father children throughout his life. The distinction underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on biological realities in familial jurisprudence.
